evidence_cutoff: pre-treatment committed context-spinoff checkpoints and public recording metadata

mechanical_rule.causal-control-opportunity: first four lexicographic completed context-spinoff checkpoints with one or more eligible opportunities
mechanical_rule.existing-partial-progress: first two lexicographic remaining recordings with max(levels_completed)>0 and terminal state != WIN
mechanical_rule.negative-control: first lexicographic remaining completed checkpoint with zero eligible opportunities and max(levels_completed)=0
